usage: cox lake [-h] {sync,query,doctor} ...

The Iceberg lake: sync the run store and traces into it, query it with SQL, and check it. Needs the optional extra `lake`.

positional arguments:
  {sync,query,doctor}
    sync               append new run-store rows and register new trace files; --dry-run writes
                       nothing
    query              run DuckDB SQL over the lake tables (runs, phases, ...) and print the rows
    doctor             check the lake: catalog, namespace, warehouse and each table; exits 1 on a
                       failed check

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit

examples:
  cox lake sync
  cox lake sync --dry-run --json
  cox lake query "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM runs"
  cox lake doctor
